title: Per-user access control for Bedrock KB tools
caption:
Your agent searches company docs for a user. Who decides which user?

If the search tool takes "who to search as" as an argument, the LLM decides. One prompt injection and it searches as someone else.

AWS published a pattern for Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base behind AgentCore Gateway. The rule: don't let the LLM decide who the user is.

How it works:
1. A request interceptor (Lambda) overwrites userContext from the validated JWT
2. ACL awareness returns only documents that user may view
3. A Cedar policy denies the call if userContext.userId doesn't match the token's email
4. A resource-based policy denies every principal except the gateway role

Gotcha: ACL mistakes don't throw errors. Documents are silently left out of results.

Save this before you ship a multi-tenant agent. Which layer are you missing today? Tell me in the comments.

Source: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/fine-grained-access-control-for-amazon-bedrock-managed-knowledge-base-tools/

slides.headline: Never let the LLM decide ==who the user is.==
slides.sub: Per-user access control for a shared agent and knowledge base.

slides.title: The problem
paragraphs: One assistant, one knowledge base, every employee. Dept A must not see B's docs.
If the search tool takes **who to search as** as an argument, the **LLM sets it**. Injection can spoof it.
slides.callout: The model should never write an auth value.

slides.title: Four layers, one request
slides.foot: Plus a ==resource policy== on the knowledge base.

slides.title: Per-document ACL
slides.foot: Pass ==userContext.userId== at query time to scope results.

slides.title: Primary fix: overwrite it
slides.foot: Trusted code sets it from the ==verified token.==

slides.title: Backup: Cedar policy
slides.foot: Denies the call if the ==interceptor failed.==

slides.title: Close the side doors
paragraphs: A **resource-based policy** on the knowledge base denies Retrieve and GetDocumentContent to every principal except the gateway execution role.
That blocks a second gateway or a direct SDK call, **even from admins**.
slides.callout: Don't share the gateway role with other workloads.
